executiveSummary: The latest technology news highlights major trends in AI/ML, hardware releases, and industry shifts. Apple's iPhone 18 Pro and Car Keys, as well as the new M5 Ultra chip, are notable developments. AI data centers and their environmental impact are also a growing concern.

takeaways.title: AI/ML growth
takeaways.description: The growth of AI/ML is expected to have a significant impact on the environment, with US data centers potentially consuming more natural gas than Germany and Japan combined by 2035, according to TechCrunch.

takeaways.title: Hardware releases
takeaways.description: The new iPhone 18 Pro and Car Keys, as well as the AirPods 5, are notable hardware releases that demonstrate Apple's continued innovation in the tech industry.

takeaways.title: Industry shifts
takeaways.description: The shift towards more sustainable and environmentally-friendly technologies is becoming increasingly important, with AI data centers and their environmental impact being a growing concern.

worthWatching: Apple's use of AI to verify the authenticity of photos with its new Reference Image camera mode, as described in MacRumors.
engineeringPerspective: The development of the new M5 Ultra chip, which offers impressive performance gains and is expected to be used in the new Mac Studio, as described in MacRumors.
